Hi Elena / Marco —

Quick weekly checkpoint for the MAP and trial milestones. Attached is the working MAP workbook (novum_map_v1.xlsx) and our trial evaluation checklist (redwood-trial-eval-checklist.pdf). High-level status below: 

- Scope: API-based inference for document summarization (3 models) + embedding search.
- Current phase: Environment setup + baseline throughput test (run scheduled this week).
- Key open blockers: Novum test dataset anonymization, VPC peering config awaiting cloud ops approval.

Immediate asks / owners (owners in parentheses):
1) Provide a sanitized sample dataset (10–20 docs) by Thu 6/26 (Elena).
2) Confirm procurement timeline for Dedicated trial credits — procurement contact looped (Marco / Procurement).
3) Cloud networking: share VPC CIDR and contact for peering (Marco) — aim for peering by 6/30.
4) Redwood: baseline perf run and initial acceptance metrics posted to the MAP doc (Mina / Rishi).

Planned acceptance criteria for POC (short):
- Successful inference on sample dataset with median latency < 350ms for 512-token prompts.
- Embedding recall >= 0.82 on a 100-query test set.
- No PII leakage on sanitized dataset audit report.

I propose we keep the weekly 30-minute sync on Fridays at 11am PT; can shift if it conflicts.

Notes: I put owners in the MAP workbook and added a first-pass evaluation matrix. Please ack and update owners/ETA in the sheet.

Thanks —
Mina
Mina Haddad
